Never again would the rule of law, merit, and procedure protect the weakest
members of the galaxy. Instead, the farce of the Galactic Republic would keep
the strong in power and the reformers divided. At least if Jedi have their way.
Although Palpatine had succeeded in destroying most of the Jedi Council, the
oldest Jedi warlock, Yoda, had eluded the Empire's reach. With him the
knowledge of Force-Ghost creation remained stubornly extant.
Using the greatest and most terrible secrets of the Jedi at their disposal, the
"rebel alliance" managed to destroy the Empire's battle station, and with Lord
Vader's son, Luke, put together a plan to suborn the elder Jedi turned Sith.
